title: Virus Injection Protocol
author: Liu Liu
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bctxiwpn
materials: Re-wet the area and zoom in.

steps.title: Pull and Break Glass Pipettes
steps.instruction: Pull thin-walled Drummond glass symmetrically using a P-2000 (Sutter) or equivalent. Inspect the tip under a microforge or microscope and carefully break it against a solid surface to achieve a tip diameter of approximately 20μm.

steps.title: Bevel the Pipette Tips
steps.instruction: Mount the pipette on a beveler at a 35° angle or less to horizontal, with the broken end roughly flush with the platter. Use a wet kimwipe with 70% EtOH to maintain a wet drive surface and prevent glass dust from entering the pipette.

substeps.instruction: Start the hard drive.
Lower the pipette to briefly touch the spinning surface and return.
Verify success by checking if EtOH enters the pipette tip during sharpening.

steps.title: Clean and Sort Pipettes
steps.instruction: Inspect the pipette and use canned air to blow out any internal or external dust. Bevel at least 3 pipettes and arrange them by quality, using the best one first and others as backups.

steps.title: Prepare Workspace and Materials
steps.instruction: Sterilize the workspace and prepare tools (refer to headbar protocol). Cut gel foam into 1mm cubes and soak them in cortex buffer.

steps.title: Align Injection Hardware
steps.instruction: Adjust the alignment of the pipette holder and the plunger holder so that the two attachment channels are straight and co-linear.

steps.title: Load Virus into Pipette
steps.instruction: Prepare a loading station and fill the pipette with virus.

substeps.instruction: Place a tiny platform adjacent to the mouse head holder and wrap with parafilm.
Fill the pipette with mineral oil, avoiding bubbles.
Mount the injector and eject any bubbles.
Carefully suck up the virus from a drop placed on the parafilm.

steps.title: Perform Craniotomy
steps.instruction: Prepare the skull and create an entry point for the injection.

substeps.instruction: Wet the skull with cortex buffer to visualize vasculature.
Confirm the target and dry the skull.
Drill a small hole directly above the target; stop when bone cracking or peeling indicates the dura is reached.

steps.title: Position Pipette and Prime Tip
steps.instruction: Position the pipette directly above the craniotomy, ensuring the injector hydraulics do not hit the scope support.

substeps.instruction: Eject a small volume of virus to remove bubbles and wick away the drop using saline-soaked gel foam.
Set lighting at a fair distance and moderate brightness to maintain thermal steady state and prevent volume expansion.

steps.title: Inject Virus
steps.instruction: Perform the injection at the specified depth and rate.

substeps.instruction: Position the needle onto the surface of the craniotomy and zero the manipulator.
Lower the pipette to the desired depth at 2 μm/s.
Inject the desired amount (typically 10-100 nL) of virus at 0.5 nL/s.

steps.title: Verify Injection and Seal Site
steps.instruction: Check for clogs and seal the craniotomy.

substeps.instruction: Test for clogs by ejecting a small volume; if clogged, repeat with a new pipette.
Wipe the pipette with wet gel foam and eject a tiny drop to seal the end.
If a large area of skull was thinned, coat it with a small volume of Krazy glue.
Fill the area with Kwik-Cast and cover with dental acrylic.

steps.title: Post-Injection Recovery and Retraction
steps.instruction: Allow the virus to diffuse before removing the pipette.

substeps.instruction: Leave the pipette in tissue for 00:20:00.
Maintain a wet surface on the craniotomy to prevent tissue from sticking to the pipette.
Slowly retract the pipette from the brain at 5-10 μm/s, ensuring no bleeding occurs at the site.

steps.title: Cleanup and Disposal
steps.instruction: Dispose of all virus handling parts in a labeled, sealed 50mL conical tube.

steps.title: Hardware Operation Note
steps.instruction: To operate the Narishige injection system: mount the pipette in the holder, insert the plunger into the back end, and turn the knob clockwise to eject and counter-clockwise to suck.
